svg.aria-label: ArbEPI workflow: scan configuration, sampling masks and echo-train partitioning produce four Pulseq sequences (deGRE, noise, EPIcal, ArbEPI); these are exported to GE .pge files and run on the scanner; each sequence's raw ScanArchive feeds its own preprocessing step (whitening, odd/even calibration, gridding, coil maps and B0); the preprocessed file feeds RSS or iterative SENSE reconstruction. scan_info.mat bypasses the scanner and carries the sampling schedule to preprocessing.
svg.title: ArbEPI pipeline
svg.text: scan_info.mat, which goes around the scanner

g.text: ge/ checks read the same spec
resolution, matrix, R, ETL, TE, volume TR, readout slews
derives Nshots, then TR and flip angle
one (ky, kz) mask per frame: pd · caipi · ticaipi · rand
or the custom mask, passed through from Params
split each frame's samples into Nshots trains of ETL echoes
schedules · Nframes × Nshots × ETL × (ky, kz, t)
checks all four first: gradient, slew, B1 limits · PNS (fails above 100%, warns above 80%) · acoustics (warns)
then seq2ceq → writeceq writes one .pge per sequence (pure Python port of PulCeq)
runs each .pge as a pge2 entry; raw data saved as GE ScanArchives (HDF5, read only by the Orchestra SDK)
Stage A (dotted) · all coils, cached, resumable
matrix per x on the EPI grid;
apply T to every cached frame
and to the gridded noise scan
ksp_epi_zf, ksp_calib, smaps, b0map_hz, r2star, omegas, echo_times, W, cc_matrix; attrs noise_var, t_ref_s
the three maps also go to .nii.gz + .json for viewing
min over x of ½‖Ax − y‖² + g(x)
A: SENSE · + B0 (time-segmented, L = 32) · + B0 + R2*
g → solver: none → CG · lowrank → POGM · wavelet-tv → PDHG
